Present appeals are filed by appellants/original claimants in Land Acquisition Reference Nos.448 of 2005 and 449 of 2005 respectively, seeking enhancement of compensation.

entities.text: Land Acquisition Reference Nos.448 of 2005 and 449 of 2005
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The appellants land was acquired under award dated 03.10.2002 passed by Land Acquisition Officer.
The Land Acquisition Officer was pleased to award compensation @ Rs.70,500/- per hectare and Rs.61,500/- per hectare.
Aggrieved by assessment of compensation by Land Acquisition Officer, appellants had made reference under Section 18 of Land Acquisition Act.
The Reference Court awarded compensation @ Rs.1,00,000/- per hectare.

2. Learned advocates appearing for respective parties submit that in connected matters arising out of same acquisition, 969-fa-4288-2016 aw.odt compromise has been arrived between parties before National Lok Adalat dated 30.04.2023.

As per settlement, compensation has been agreed @ Rs.2,00,000/- per hectare for Jirayat land and Rs.1,00,000/- per hectare for Pot Kharab land keeping statutory benefits intact as awarded by Reference Court.
3. The copy of compromise pursis and copy of award passed by Lok Adalat in First Appeal No.7073 of 2023 in L.A.R. No.441 of 2005 is placed before this Court to substantiate the contentions.

It appears that parties have arrived at amicable Arjun Nimba Thakare vs The State Of Maharashtra And Others on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124737958/
1 settlement in respect of compensation towards acquired lands for Amrawatinala Minor Irrigation Tank.
4. In that view of matter, present appeals are partly allowed.

sentences.text:
The appellants/original claimants are held entitled for enhanced compensation @ Rs.2,00,000/-
per hectare along with consequential benefits as awarded by Reference Court.

However, interest shall be payable as per law laid down by this Court in case of State of Maharashtra Vs. Kailash Shiva Rangari reported in 2016 AIR (Bom)
141.
